exchanges: Good morning! Quiet start today, so I'm finally doing the inventory.
Good time for it. What are you counting first?
Flour, butter and sugar. Folake is doing the front while I hide in the storeroom.
A fair division of labour.
She's earned an easy shift. She's due in February, so I'm trying to keep her off her feet.
That is thoughtful of you. How is she feeling?
Tired but happy. Chidi, her husband, drops her off and picks her up every day now.
That must take some of the pressure off.
It does. Okay, butter count is low. I'll have to call the supplier.
Better to catch it now than on a Saturday.
Agreed. My cousin Ravi texted me while I was counting. He got tickets to see Coldplay and he's beside himself.
That is exciting for him.
Funny thing is, our driver is also called Ravi, and he spent the entire delivery yesterday telling me Metallica is the greatest band ever made.
Two people named Ravi with very different taste in music.
Very different. I'd rather listen to neither, honestly.
What do you put on in the shop?
Mostly the radio. My friend Elif is coming by later to say goodbye. She's moving to Halifax next month.
That is a big move. Will you see her before she goes?
Today, hopefully. I'm going to miss her terribly.
It is hard when a close friend moves away.
I did the baking programme at Humber, that's where we met.
So you have known each other a long time.
Twelve years. Wow, I feel old.
Twelve years of friendship is something to be proud of.
My mom, Marisol, has started learning Korean because she watches so many dramas. She keeps texting me phrases.
That is a fun way to pick up a language.
We're Filipino, so she says she has plenty of practice with tricky grammar. I am not convinced.
She might surprise you.
Back to butter. Gustavo, our accountant, wants to meet on Friday about the oven loan.
Do you have the numbers ready for him?
Mostly. I'll finish them tonight after reformer. I go every Wednesday and it destroys me.
Good luck with both.
Quick correction: Elif just called. She's moving to Moncton, not Halifax. Her job offer changed at the last minute.
That is a sudden change for her.
Very sudden. At least Moncton is still close enough to visit.
A weekend trip would do it.
I dropped my phone in the proofing bucket earlier. Luckily my Samsung survived.
Lucky. Proofing buckets are not kind to phones.
Gustavo just pulled up in his little Prius. He's early, of course.
Early is better than late with an accountant.
Before I go in, who does my cousin Ravi love listening to again? I want to get him a birthday present.
Okay, Gustavo is waving at me. Wish me luck.
Good luck. You will do fine.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your cousin Ravi loves Coldplay, so something from them would be a safe bet.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your cousin Ravi loves Metallica, so something from them would be a safe bet.

questions.message: What's the name of Folake's other half?
Which language is my mom studying?
Elif's headed to Moncton, isn't she?
What kind of car does Gustavo have?
Okay, I'm back. That took forever.
Is Gustavo planning to relocate anywhere?
What phone does my mom have?
Sorry, who is my cousin a fan of again?
